## Problem

When run is selected, recent-runs browse table can dominate before selected-run status/funnel/action narrative.

## Scope

- [ ] Empty browse mode remains population-first
- [ ] Remain canonical hub for full ID/Processed Records

- [ ] Empty vs selected modes explicit (DSA-08 residual)
